Q0 (2026-10-12): the shared block cache is built by RuntimeCaps::with_config, so run takes runtime_caps.shared_cache instead of building a FoyerCache, and starts the idle-release loop with idle::start(&state, &tasks). Compaction guard (2026-10-26): the shard log opens through native_queue::compaction_guard::shard_log_builder, whose size-tiered scheduler also refuses a submitted compaction that shares a sorted run or SST view with a live one, instead of Db::builder(..).with_settings(..); without it the 100x queue run of 2026-10-25 on slate 409acbc8 crash-looped shard 10 on SlateDB's compaction-worker assertion (a collector pass beside the embedded scheduler's compaction into the last run). Layout 6 (2026-10-27): the engine builds its layout state with one field line (`layout: layout::LayoutState::default()`, where every later layout 6 engine state lives) and no longer takes the absorber's channel (`absorb_tx` is an `AbsorberLink` the absorber attaches when it starts), so the opener in `bootstrap::run` creates no channel and passes none; these are the gate's after values.
